I hard disagree with the survivability thing.  Ironclad very frequently has to trade life in fights, while Silent (with dexterity + weak), Necrobinder (with the 3 best block commons in the game), and Defect (with frost + focus) can very much just chill and full block every turn even on ascension 10.

That said, ironclad is VERY good at trading life because of his starter relic.  My point is that it is difficult for him to escape combats without taking damage.
